title: Professional Email Late-Payment Fee on Reactivation Renewals
content:
**Fee schedule.** The late-payment fee of a Professional Email reactivation renewal is Harborline's published flat fee read from the calendar days from the due date, the term end date, to the day it is paid.

| Calendar days from the term end date to the day the reactivation renewal is paid | Late-payment fee (USD) |
|---|---|
| 15 days or more | 15.00 |
| from 4 up to 14 days | 10.00 |
| from 1 up to 3 days | 5.00 |
| paid on or before the due date | none |

The late-payment fee is never reduced by any rate and is added to the rounded renewal component of the reactivation renewal.

## Edges

| Days late | Fee |
|---|---|
| 3 | 5.00 |
| 4 | 10.00 |
| 14 | 10.00 |
| 15 | 15.00 |

Example (hypothetical): a term ending on 2 June whose reactivation renewal is paid on 19 June is 17 days late and carries 15.00.
